Merge FBref tables into a player-season master table

Source: R/merge_fbref_tables.R
merge_fbref_tables.Rd

Joins standardized FBref tables into a single player-season dataset keyed by team, season, and player. When standard is provided, overlapping columns from other tables are joined with table-specific suffixes (e.g. _shooting) and then dropped, keeping the standard version as source of truth.

Usage

merge_fbref_tables(
  standard = NULL,
  shooting = NULL,
  passing = NULL,
  defensive = NULL,
  possession = NULL,
  key = c("team", "season", "player"),
  strict = TRUE
)

Arguments

standard

Tibble from import_fbref_standard(). Recommended.

shooting

Tibble from import_fbref_shooting(). Optional.

passing

Tibble from import_fbref_passing(). Optional.

defensive

Tibble from import_fbref_defensive_actions(). Optional.

possession

Tibble from import_fbref_possession(). Optional.

key

Character vector of join keys. Default: c("team","season","player").

strict

If TRUE, stops when duplicated keys are detected within any input table.

Value

A tibble with one row per player-season and columns from all provided tables.
